data.narrative:
AST SpaceMobile is a publicly listed space and aerospace company that has raised $2B+ to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comparable universe of 4 public-stage peers in the Space & Aerospace sector: Rocket Lab ($40.0B), Planet Labs ($7.6B), Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B), and Astroscale ($840M).

The peer-median method applies directly given AST SpaceMobile's public status and sector alignment. The median valuation across these four same-stage, same-sector comparables is $5.2B, with a range spanning $840M at the low end to $40.0B at the high end. This wide dispersion reflects the heterogeneity in Space & Aerospace business models and development stages. A public-comps anchoring approach using P/S multiples across 6 sector tickers (median 27.4x) cannot be applied in this analysis due to the absence of disclosed revenue figures.

The triangulated valuation range supported by the available data is $4.4B to $6.0B, centered on a $5.2B median. This range reflects uncertainty around where AST SpaceMobile sits relative to its peer cohort in terms of operational maturity, addressable market capture, and path to profitability. Key uncertainties include lack of revenue disclosure, which prevents multiple-based cross-checks, and the substantial dispersion within the peer set itself, suggesting that stage and business model composition materially drive valuations in this sector.
